findings.evidence: Uniformizer.lean:36–37 and Region.lean:97 introduce the stronger assumptions. The proofs at Uniformizer.lean:96,131 and Region.lean:104,143 use valuation algebra and DVR facts only; Mathlib/RingTheory/DiscreteValuationRing/Basic.lean:96 provides Irreducible.maximalIdeal_eq at the DVR level.
findings.fix: State these four results under [Field K] [ValuativeRel K] [IsDiscreteValuationRing (valuation K).integer], introducing local-field assumptions only for the topological and measure results.
findings.issue: Both forall_valuation_le_iff_notMem_maximalIdeal_sq and image_maximalIdeal_pow_eq_smul inherit unnecessary topology and local-field assumptions; the same restriction propagates to mem_eisensteinSet_iff_exists_isEisensteinAt and eisensteinSet_eq_sdiff in Eisenstein/Region.lean.

summary: Four algebraic results unnecessarily require a nonarchimedean local field, preventing their use for general discretely valued fields.
